calls.prompt: Create a production game CLOUD SPRITE ATLAS on TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, not a sky painting. Use the supplied CC0 cloud reference as real inspiration for the delicate natural vapor shape, but turn its neutral gray density into luminous clean white cloud body with only very pale cool-blue internal softness. No dark gray smoke or black shadow; no baked directional light, hard highlights, neon, horizon, ground, city, building, character, text, symbol, frame, checkerboard or solid-colored rectangle. Square 2048x2048 requested native output. A precisely regular 2-by-2 atlas: one INDEPENDENT cloud cluster centered INSIDE EACH of the four equal quadrants, each cluster with its own different silhouette. Leave broad TRUE TRANSPARENT empty gutters along the central horizontal and vertical cell divisions and around the outer canvas; no cloud or wisp crosses any cell edge, no decorative separator lines. Each cloud fills at most 70% of its quadrant width and height and has feathered SEMITRANSPARENT wispy alpha edges, a recognizable brighter translucent core, and transparent surrounding air. Keep clusters separated so each quadrant can be sampled as one sprite with clean UVs. Four distinct clusters, not the same cloud copied or rotated. Soft natural rounded vapor, controlled delicate detail suitable for a bright fantasy game. Preserve actual transparency in the output alpha channel. Variant 01: airy rounded white cumulus puffs. The top-left is a wide modest three-lobe cloud; top-right a compact two-lobe cloud with a small independent nearby puff; bottom-left a low flattened cotton cluster; bottom-right an asymmetric small cluster with a tapering soft tail. Bright restrained ivory-white cores and extremely subtle icy-blue cool underside, without a hard outlined cartoon contour.
